title: Irrigation mapping with deep learning
text: Automated detection of center-pivot irrigation systems from Landsat 8, Sentinel-2 and NAIP imagery. A custom ArcGIS tool handles data prep and large-scale inference. YOLOv11 outperformed U-Net, Faster R-CNN and Mask R-CNN, a step toward sustainable groundwater management in semi-arid regions.
alt: Center-pivot irrigation systems detected in satellite imagery

title: UAS phenotyping of field crops
text: Multispectral data integration and stacked ensemble learning to estimate yield, protein and maturity in dry peas; YOLOv12 segmentation for dry bean stand counting; and a synthesis of 211 studies on measuring above-ground biomass with UAS sensors, from RGB to hyperspectral and LiDAR.
alt: UAS imagery of field crop plots

title: Hyperspectral imaging & seed quality
text: Classifying seeds and assessing quality traits from hyperspectral imagery, bringing lab-grade spectroscopy into high-throughput pipelines for breeding programs and seed-industry partners.

title: Precision agriculture for Montana
text: A producer-engaged program at MSU: decision-support tools, variable-rate strategies and on-farm experimentation tuned to the dryland and irrigated systems of the Northern Great Plains.
